text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Desire, thanks for the birthday present! 
That chain necklace is ridiculously cool!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Oh my...! That's wonderful to hear. The 
chunky chain and sleek silver... I thought 
they would suit you perfectly, Vodka-san.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
And that charm that came with it too! The 
one with wings bursting out of a 
horseshoe! It's got such an edgy design, 
so cool!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... Actually, that charm was something 
I added on later. Holy wings fluttering 
under a divine blessing—

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
May your running overcome even the trials 
of the world. ...A modest prayer from this 
Saint.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
"...! With my running, I'll overcome the 
world's trials...!"

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Just like in those delinquent manga! The 
protagonist talking smack and charging 
head-on into a world-class rival... Oh, 
hell yeah!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
World stage or whatever, it doesn't 
matter! I'll pin 'em down in style with my 
running!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
(...Ah, Vodka! What an incredible person 
you are... So truly, genuinely 
gallant...!)

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
(A strength that flinches before nothing, 
one that inspires absolute devotion...\nI 
want to watch it forever, I want to stay 
by her side forever!\nThat is precisely 
why I...!)

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
“—Yes. I offer my prayers for you. May the 
Saint's blessing... be upon you.”
